root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic branches: dispersal, separation, and movement apart; and a vessel or measure.
root_idea.development: The dispersal branch extends to scattering, splitting, retreating, and approaching or encompassing from different sides. The vessel branch includes the ṣāʿ measure and the ṣuwāʿ drinking vessel.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun صُوَاع is a distinct lexical item and appears once in the Quran.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Joseph narrative, the royal ṣuwāʿ is understood as a vessel from which one drinks.
An alternative interpretation of the object in the same Quranic passage identifies it as a measure used for measuring, while also describing it as a vessel that could be used for drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To measure something with a ṣāʿ measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verb; the measured object may be food or grain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach, encompass, or collect from different sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of a courageous person approaching or encompassing opponents, and of a herder collecting livestock from every side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disperse or scatter something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported with opponents and with livestock; some authorities also give this as a contrary usage to collecting them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To frighten someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To urge or incite a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I construction with a collective object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To propel a ball with a club or mallet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sporting or playing construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow one another in succession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of bees moving after one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fold, double, twist, or bend a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I usage describing alteration of an object's shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare and level a place for separating and loosening cotton.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction with a place as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dry up or cause plants or herbage to dry up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported with the wind as subject; the usage is compared with صَوَّحَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing pointed at its head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To round a thing at its sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II usage concerning the shape of an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive female asses to the right and left.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II construction reported of a wild ass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go at random and resist one's owner or rider.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of a horse in a Form II usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn the head or face toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with إِلَيْهِ indicating the direction of turning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move or bob the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of a bird moving its head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dispersed, scattered, or remote from one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V usage, including a people or party becoming dispersed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For hair to contract, split, disperse, or fall out gradually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V usage describing the effects of dryness or progressive loss.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For herbage to become dried up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V usage of vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away or back, retreat, or go away quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VII usage describing rapid departure, often with the sense of retreating or returning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a bird to ascend or mount into the air.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive usage describing movement between earth and sky or into the middle of the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plot in which a ṣāʿ of seed is sown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place-noun usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depressed piece or hollow in the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place may be described as excavated, sloping down from its borders, or narrow and depressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cleared or bare place, especially a swept place where one plays.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place is described as cleared of pebbles and suitable for playing with a ball; it may also simply be bare.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place at the breast of an ostrich when it rests its breast on the ground; by extension, the middle of the breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression صَاعُ جُؤْجُؤِ النَّعَامِ and in an idiom for striking someone in the middle of the breast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A goffstick or mallet used to propel a ball.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun usage associated with ball play.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Portions of herbage beginning to dry up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or collective noun describing partially dried vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Horseflesh that is scattered or sparse rather than collected in one place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive noun usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or prepared hide used for separating and loosening cotton or wool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place may be prepared by a woman and may consist of a skin spread out for the work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place specially made or prepared for guests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place-noun usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who is turning away or back, retreating, or departing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle from Form VII, used for a person or party in rapid retreat or departure.
